title: Flow Storage Post
description: Post data for the Flow storage endpoint. Exactly one of `limit` or `object_ids` must be provided — omitting both returns 400, providing both also returns 400.

limit.description: Allocate this many new Media Objects, with server-generated identifiers. Maximum 100 per request. A request above the maximum is rejected with 400 rather than truncated, so a partial allocation is never mistaken for a complete one; the client asks again for the rest.

object_ids.description: Array of client-specified object_ids to allocate. Maximum 100 per request. The supplied object_ids must not already exist in this TAMS service instance. A 400 response is returned if any supplied object_id already exists. Clients may re-request an object_id that was previously allocated but has not yet been registered as a segment (e.g. after a presigned URL expired).

storage_id.description: The Storage Backend to allocate storage in. A Storage Backend identifier as advertised at the [/service/storage-backends](#/operations/GET_storage-backends) endpoint. If not set the default, as advertised at the [/service/storage-backends](#/operations/GET_storage-backends) endpoint, will be used if available. An invalid Storage Backend identifier will result in a 400 error.
